title: Learn how to tag an AI opportunity

contentBody.description: Learn how to tag an AI opportunity so that you can request support and so that it will appear in the AI pipeline.

sections.content: For more details on how to tag a deal so that it shows up in the AI pipeline, go here: https://intel.sharepoint.com/:p:/s/saleskpidocs/EQw98pKENJBJhjZB_O57qzkB-ySh8ZOMTFklXjpErpXh-Q?e=hwfBj8
